recursivefactory.configuration.title: Recursive Factory Settings
Control rotation, fluid and item transfer independently.
recursivefactory.configuration.repairBro: Restore missing checkerboard tiles when preparing a room. Existing blocks are preserved.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkEnabl: Connect paired surface nodes when Create: Electro Energetics is installed.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkResis: Series resistance per end. The default of 10 ohms keeps the connected grids stable.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkRespo: Fraction of the target adjustment applied each tick.
recursivefactory.configuration.linkMaxCu: Maximum current requested by each end of a link.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer rotation and stress. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer fluids. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.
Allow factory entrances and room barriers to transfer items. Enabled by default; disabled by default when Create Ender Transmission (createendertransmission) is loaded. Saved choices take priority.
